Byers |asst_coach3=[[Brent Scott (basketball)|Brent Scott]] |asst_coach4= |stadium=[[Tudor Fieldhouse]] |champion= |bowl=[[2017 College Basketball Invitational|CBI]] |bowl_result=Quarterfinals }} {{2016–17 Conference USA men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 Rice Owls men's basketball team''' represented [[Rice University]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Owls, led by third-year head coach [[Mike Rhoades]], played their home games at [[Tudor Fieldhouse]] in [[Houston|Houston, Texas]] as members of [[Conference USA]]. They finished the season 23–12, 11–7 in [[2016–17 Conference USA men's basketball season|C-USA play]] to finish in fifth place. They defeated [[2016–17 Southern Miss Golden Eagles basketball team|Southern Miss]] in the first round of the [[2017 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]] before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2016–17 UTEP Miners men's basketball team|UTEP]]. They received an invitation to the [[2017 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] where they defeated [[2016–17 San Francisco Dons men's basketball team|San Francisco]] in the first round before losing in the quarterfinals to [[2016–17 Utah Valley Wolverines men's basketball team|Utah Valley]]. On March 21, 2017, head coach Mike Rhoades resigned to become the head coach at [[VCU Rams men's basketball|VCU]].{{cite web | url=http://www.houstonchronicle.com/sports/rice/article/Mike-Rhoades-leaving-Rice-for-VCU-job-11018710.php | title=Mike Rhoades leaving Rice for VCU job | date=22 March 2017 }} He finished at Rice with a three-year record of 47–52. On March 23, the school promoted assistant coach [[Scott Pera]] to head coach.{{Cite web|url=http://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2017/03/23/rice-promotes-scott-pera-to-head-coach/|title=Rice promotes Scott Pera to head coach|last=Payne|first=Terrence|date=2017-03-23|website=CollegeBasketballTalk|access-date=2017-04-13}} ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Rice Owls men's basketball team|Owls]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 12–20, 7–11 in [[2015–16 Conference USA men's basketball season|C-USA play]] to finish in a three-way tie for ninth place. They lost in the second round of the [[2016 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]] to [[2015–16 Charlotte 49ers men's basketball team|Charlotte]]. == Preseason == The Owls were picked to finish in ninth place in the preseason Conference USA poll.{{Cite web|url=http://conferenceusa.com/news/2016/10/6/MBK_1006161210.aspx|title=MBK: UAB Voted C-USA Preseason Favorite|website=Conference USA|language=en|access-date=2017-01-25}} Marcus Evans was selected to the preseason All-Conference USA team. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
